name: concept-explainer
title: Concept explainer
description: Solo explanation of one system-design concept with real incidents and trade-offs.
authoring_brief: One concept per episode. Lead with the failure it prevents, not the definition. Every claim about a real company or incident belongs in a factual section with a source.

sections.title: Why this matters
sections.brief: The failure mode this concept exists to prevent.

sections.title: How it works
sections.brief: The mechanism, built up from the simplest version.

sections.title: In the wild
sections.brief: Named systems and incidents. Requires sources[].

sections.title: Trade-offs
sections.brief: Costs, and the conditions under which you would not use it.

sections.title: In an interview
sections.brief: How to raise it without sounding rehearsed.
